item.title: Core Keeper Automation Guide — Auto Farms, Drills and Power Circuits That Actually Work
item.description: Once your base has smelters and chests, the next time sink is feeding them. This automation guide goes past the basics: how power actually travels, which machines to put on the Automation Table, and four farm layouts — ore boulders, wood, crops and mobs — that run while you explore. How electricity really works Every automation machine needs a powered tile next to it (or a run of Electrical Wire). Powered machines show yellow notches on the four sides of their base.
